options.query: SELECT id, full_name AS label, role_key, department, job_title, email FROM {{table:staff}} WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY full_name
SELECT id, full_name, email, role_key, department, job_title, phone, city, is_active, created_at FROM {{table:staff}} WHERE id = $1::int
UPDATE {{table:staff}} SET full_name = $2::text, department = $3::text, job_title = $4::text, phone = $5::text, city = $6::text, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id

SELECT "id", "subject", "customer_id", "requester_name", "status", "priority", "channel", "category", "assignee_id", "sla_due_at", "first_response_at", "resolved_at", "satisfaction_score", "description", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at" FROM {{table:tickets}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND "assignee_id" = $1::int ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT n.id, n.title, n.body, n.category, n.is_read, n.link_page, n.created_at, s.full_name AS staff_name
FROM {{table:notifications}} n LEFT JOIN {{table:staff}} s ON s.id = n.staff_id
WHERE n.staff_id = $1::int
ORDER BY n.is_read ASC, n.created_at DESC LIMIT 200
UPDATE {{table:notifications}} SET is_read = true WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) RETURNING id

INSERT INTO {{table:notifications}} (staff_id, title, body, category, is_read, link_page, created_at)
VALUES ($1::int, $2::text, $3::text, $4::text, false, $5::text, now())
RETURNING id
SELECT id, kind, config_key, config_value, label, updated_at FROM {{table:app_config}} WHERE kind = ANY($1::text[]) ORDER BY kind, config_key
UPDATE {{table:app_config}} SET config_value = $3::jsonb, updated_at = now() WHERE kind = $1::text AND config_key = $2::text RETURNING id, config_key, config_value
SELECT id, config_key, config_value, label, updated_at FROM {{table:app_config}} WHERE kind = 'saved_view' AND config_key LIKE $1::text || '%' ORDER BY label

INSERT INTO {{table:app_config}} (kind, config_key, config_value, label, updated_at)
VALUES ('saved_view', $1::text, $2::jsonb, $3::text, now())
ON CONFLICT (kind, config_key) DO UPDATE SET config_value = EXCLUDED.config_value, label = EXCLUDED.label, updated_at = now()
RETURNING id

SELECT c.id, c.entity, c.entity_id, c.body, c.created_at, c.updated_at, s.full_name AS author
FROM {{table:comments}} c LEFT JOIN {{table:staff}} s ON s.id = c.author_id
WHERE c.entity = $1::text AND c.entity_id = $2::int AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

INSERT INTO {{table:comments}} (entity, entity_id, author_id, body, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1::text, $2::int, $3::int, $4::text, now(), now()) RETURNING id

SELECT a.id, a.entity, a.entity_id, a.file_name, a.file_url, a.mime_type, a.created_at, s.full_name AS uploaded_by_name
FROM {{table:attachments}} a LEFT JOIN {{table:staff}} s ON s.id = a.uploaded_by
WHERE a.entity = $1::text AND a.entity_id = $2::int ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

INSERT INTO {{table:attachments}} (entity, entity_id, file_name, file_url, mime_type, uploaded_by, created_at)
VALUES ($1::text, $2::int, $3::text, $4::text, $5::text, $6::int, now()) RETURNING id

SELECT id, entity, entity_id, action, actor, old_data, new_data, created_at,
  (action || ' · ' || entity) AS title,
  COALESCE(actor, 'system') AS description
FROM {{table:audit_log}}
WHERE ($1::text = '' OR entity = $1::text)
  AND ($2::int IS NULL OR entity_id = $2::int)
  AND ($3::text = '' OR actor ILIKE '%' || $3::text || '%')
  AND (NULLIF($4::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($4::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($5::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($5::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT "id", "subject", "customer_id", "requester_name", "status", "priority", "channel", "category", "assignee_id", "sla_due_at", "first_response_at", "resolved_at", "satisfaction_score", "description", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at" FROM {{table:tickets}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND "assignee_id" = $1::int
AND "status" NOT IN ('resolved', 'closed')
ORDER BY "sla_due_at" ASC LIMIT 12

SELECT r."roleID" AS "roleID", r."roleTitle", r."roleDescription", count(rpm."permissionID")::int AS permission_count
FROM "tblRoles" r
LEFT JOIN "tblRolePermissionMappings" rpm ON rpm."roleID" = r."roleID"
WHERE r."tenantID" = $1::uuid
GROUP BY r."roleID", r."roleTitle", r."roleDescription"
ORDER BY r."roleTitle"

SELECT * FROM (
SELECT 'tickets' AS entity, 'missing_label' AS check_name, count(*)::int AS affected_rows, 'Records with an empty display label' AS detail FROM {{table:tickets}} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND ("subject" IS NULL OR btrim("subject"::text) = '')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'customers' AS entity, 'missing_label' AS check_name, count(*)::int AS affected_rows, 'Records with an empty display label' AS detail FROM {{table:customers}} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND ("account_name" IS NULL OR btrim("account_name"::text) = '')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'subscriptions' AS entity, 'missing_label' AS check_name, count(*)::int AS affected_rows, 'Records with an empty display label' AS detail FROM {{table:subscriptions}} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND ("id" IS NULL OR btrim("id"::text) = '')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'subscriptions', 'negative_amount', count(*)::int, 'Records with a negative financial amount' FROM {{table:subscriptions}} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND "amount" < 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'payments' AS entity, 'missing_label' AS check_name, count(*)::int AS affected_rows, 'Records with an empty display label' AS detail FROM {{table:payments}} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND ("invoice_number" IS NULL OR btrim("invoice_number"::text) = '')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'payments', 'negative_amount', count(*)::int, 'Records with a negative financial amount' FROM {{table:payments}} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND "amount" < 0
) checks ORDER BY affected_rows DESC, entity
SELECT id, role_key, page_slug, can_view, can_export, updated_at FROM {{table:role_matrix}} ORDER BY role_key, page_slug
UPDATE {{table:role_matrix}} SET can_view = $3::boolean, can_export = $4::boolean, updated_at = now() WHERE role_key = $1::text AND page_slug = $2::text RETURNING id
